The '''Container Guard''' is a minor character appearing in {{SA}}.

==History==
===Background===
Nothing is known about his background prior to [[1992]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
During Carl Johnson's infiltration of the [[Da Nang Boys Freighter]], he is killed by Carl to get his key for the container with the refugees. The guard is armed with [[grenades]] and a [[Tec-9]], and he guards the refugees' container in the hull.

==Prominent Appearances in Gameplay==
*[[The Da Nang Thang]] <small>(Killed)</small>
